_about: Manually verified word starts (song seconds). Each was read off close-ups of the vocal stem (zoom_post.py: log spectrogram of the vocal and 'other' stems with SuperFlux onsets, and the per-frame character posteriors of both CTC models; zoom_plot.py: linear spectrogram, SuperFlux curve, 5 ms RMS, pYIN f0) against the 16th-note grid. u = my uncertainty in seconds. 'confirm' entries keep the automatic time but replace an uncertainty inflated by a CTC model that failed there (MMS is silent through most of chorus 1). Keys are line:word indices into lyrics.js; 'line:end' sets the end of a line's last word.
